verdict.rationale: PostHog exposes a public OpenAPI spec (openapi.json) confirming a machine-readable API reference, and docs mention API usage (posthog-docs-11), but there is no evidence of an interactive, try-it-in-browser reference with runnable code examples as the story specifies. missing for 10: an interactive docs UI (e.g., Swagger/Redoc try-it-out), runnable code snippets, and any hands-on confirmation of exploring/executing API calls from the reference.
